children: said on Thursday its first-half adjusted core earning rose 7.3% from a year earlier, as revenue grew on the back of a ramp-up in production for its Vega C launcher and Ariane 6 booster.
Adjusted earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) rose to €12.2 million ($14.18 million) in the first six months of the year.
